gesture_rules.short_release: open chat only if still a short click and movement <= slop
gesture_rules.pre_long_press_movement: cancel click candidate and long-press timer if movement > slop before long-press. Do NOT convert to immediate drag.
gesture_rules.long_press: arm dragging and suppress click even when pointer does not move
gesture_rules.drag_release: persist clamped position; play put_down; no click
gesture_rules.cancel: clear timers and release pointer capture; never open chat
gesture_rules.pointer_capture: capture accepted primary pointer after hit is confirmed; release on up/cancel/lost capture
gesture_rules.keyboard: Enter/Space opens chat; reduced motion avoids greeting animation

position.on_resize: clamp into viewport without resetting user intent

lifecycle.chat_open: hide and pause visual rendering, not business tasks
lifecycle.unmount: dispose instance resources and handlers without corrupting any shared SDK manager
lifecycle.failure: use explicit static fallback and existing assistant entry, never pretend a PNG is Live2D
